name: Fixer Undercover VR
detailed_description:
Welcome to DIY Espionage - Crack a billion‑dollar plot with a $5 wrench.

Take on the role of Agent 404, who, disguised as a maintenance worker, begins the most unconventional day at work – within the walls of Redemption Prison. In the crosshairs: ambitious warden Viktor Kozlov and his suspiciously optimistic rehabilitation program "Born Again".

Forget standard spy equipment. Here, your arsenal consists of wit, a toolbox, and absolutely everything you can get your hands on. A drill becomes a universal key, a hammer transforms into a tool of delicate "persuasion" for locks, and a randomly found cable? That's your new way to bypass security systems. Your task is to creatively utilize your surroundings to forge a path forward.

You're not alone in this mission. You're accompanied by Winston, your personal, flying, and somewhat overly talkative drone, who always has handy advice or (more often) commentary at the ready. Break through the prison systems, expose Kozlov's schemes, and find your way out before you end up on his list of the "rehabilitated".

🔧 KEY FEATURES:

DIY ESPIONAGE: Solve puzzles by using common hardware in unconventional ways. Think like a handyman, act like a spy.

SOMETIMES CREATIVITY, SOMETIMES FORCE – The game rewards ingenuity: re‑route power, splice pipes for an improvised grab pole, or simply pull the panel off the wall with brute force.

A GRIPPING MYSTERY: Uncover the truth behind the miraculous transformation of inmates and find out who is funding the secretive "Born Again" program.

FULL VR IMMERSION: Feel the weight of your tools thanks to advanced physics and haptic feedback. Spatial audio and detailed graphics pull you into the world of Redemption Prison.

AN UNLIKELY DUO – Behind every handyman stands his... sidekick. Meet your chatty partner Winston, who'll admire your ingenuity and grumble about your reckless decisions. But most importantly – he'll bail you out of trouble when your latest "brilliant" plan turns out to be not quite so brilliant after all.

🏛️ STORY - 7 CHAPTERS THROUGH REDEMPTION PRISON

Progressive investigation - each area you "repair" reveals new clues about Warden Kozlov's operation:

Prison Cells • Technical Rooms • Guard Quarters • Cafeteria & Kitchen • Warden's Office • Secret Chamber • Underground Tunnels

Each location offers unique challenges, tools, and clues about the conspiracy while maintaining your cover as an ordinary worker. Work alongside Winston, your reprogrammed delivery drone partner who brings equipment, hacks security systems, and provides witty commentary.

From former escape room designers who understand that the best puzzles make you feel like a genius when you solve them.

short_description: If you love I Expect You to Die, you'll love this MacGyver-inspired VR puzzle adventure. Play as an undercover agent infiltrating a prison to investigate a suspicious prisoner rehabilitation program. Use tools and create improvised solutions to complete missions.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 (6 GB VRAM or higher)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • VR Support: Valve Index, Meta Rift, Meta Quest 2, Meta Quest 3
  • Additional Notes: Requires a VR headset and VR-compatible controllers
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3070 / AMD Radeon RX 6800 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • VR Support: Valve Index, Meta Rift, Meta Quest 2, Meta Quest 3
  • Additional Notes: Requires a VR headset and VR-compatible controllers
